name: huemanatee
description: Human-sounding rewrites for robotic, overbalanced AI prose without invented facts or padded length.

interface.longDescription: Rewrites robotic, overbalanced prose into competent human writing. Preserves meaning and dialect, cuts throat-clearing, varies rhythm, removes common AI tells, and leaves placeholders instead of inventing facts.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this draft so it sounds like a competent human wrote it.
Humanize this prose without changing its meaning or inventing facts.
